name: anonymous-install
body: Installing, upgrading or manually downloading kalide must require no GitHub account, repo access, or token (no `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN`, no `KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`): the repo really-knows-ai/kalide is public and every release asset, the tap and the bucket are fetched anonymously. No shipped install artifact (formula, Scoop manifest, docs) may reference such a token or a private-release download mechanism.
